extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians, math educators, graduate students, and those interested in mathematical pedagogy, ethics, and equity
extracted.subtask_description: A virtue-ethics style rubric for judging mathematical work and teaching, focusing on five human desires math can meet, thirteen virtues cultivated by practice, and the concept of 'mathematical hospitality' with concrete criteria for exposition and pedagogy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Play
rubrics_metrics.description: Math as exploration, puzzles, pattern, freedom to invent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values opportunities for experimentation, recreational problem-solving, and open-ended exploration rather than only instrumental or performance-driven tasks. Encourages designing activities that foreground curiosity and creative play.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beauty
rubrics_metrics.description: Math as aesthetic experience, elegance, surprise, harmony.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treats aesthetic qualities (elegance, surprising connections, harmony) as legitimate evaluative criteria alongside correctness; encourages exposition and selection of results that reveal beauty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Truth
rubrics_metrics.description: Math as the most reliable way to know.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintains rigor, proof, and commitments to correctness and trustworthy reasoning as core values; balances aesthetic and social values with technical standards of truth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Justice
rubrics_metrics.description: Math as the language of fairness (allocations, voting, fairness theorems).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates mathematical work by whether it contributes to fair outcomes and attends to equity concerns; uses math to identify and remedy injustice where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Love
rubrics_metrics.description: Math as a community practice; collegial, mentoring, generative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values relationships, mentorship, generosity, and practices that help grow others in the field; rewards work that builds and sustains community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hopefulness
rubrics_metrics.description: The conviction that a problem has a solution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cultivate optimism in learners and practitioners by framing problems as solvable and by modeling persistence; as an evaluative trait, looks for evidence that the practitioner approaches problems with constructive expectation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Perseverance
rubrics_metrics.description: Staying on a hard problem.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values persistence and long-term engagement; in teaching and evaluation, reward continued effort, incremental progress, and strategies for sustaining work on challenging problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disposition toward beauty
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuit of elegance, not just correctness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages selecting and presenting arguments that exhibit elegance; as an assessment dimension, recognize preference for solutions that reveal structure or simplicity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Willingness to create new objects, definitions, methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rewards creative definitions, constructions, and novel approaches; values originality in framing and solving problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence of mind
rubrics_metrics.description: Not deferring to authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values critical thinking and personal judgment; encourages students/practitioners to question assumptions and develop their own reasoning rather than uncritical deference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidence in struggle
rubrics_metrics.description: Comfort with not yet knowing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes and cultivates an attitude that tolerates ambiguity and values the learning process; as an evaluative trait, looks for resilience when facing uncertainty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joyfulness
rubrics_metrics.description: Finding pleasure in the work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considers enjoyment and intrinsic motivation as positive outcomes; pedagogically, design activities that let learners experience joy in discovery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thinking for oneself
rubrics_metrics.description: Re-deriving, not memorizing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values independence in understanding: seeking derivations and comprehension over rote memorization; assessment should favor evidence of genuine understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imagination
rubrics_metrics.description: Visualizing, playing, hypothesizing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages mental visualization and speculative thinking as tools for mathematical insight; reward imaginative approaches and conjecturing in problem-solving.

rubrics_metrics.name: Circumspection
rubrics_metrics.description: Checking, doubting, looking again.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values careful checking and healthy skepticism; evaluative focus on thoroughness, verification, and attentiveness to edge cases or caveats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mathematical intuition
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizing what is plausible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acknowledges informal judgment and pattern-recognition as valuable; as a rubric element, looks for practitioners' ability to form plausible conjectures and heuristics alongside formal reasoning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hospitality (virtue)
rubrics_metrics.description: Welcoming newcomers; making the field accessible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A moral and practical commitment to inclusion in mathematical practice; instructors and authors should lower barriers, provide entry points, and actively welcome diverse participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Love (virtue)
rubrics_metrics.description: Love for the work, for the community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An attitude of care and generativity toward mathematics and colleagues; as an evaluative dimension, values actions that nurture others and the discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mathematical hospitality as a rubric
rubrics_metrics.description: Judge mathematical writing or teaching on whether it 'hosts' readers — anticipating confusion, using inclusive language, providing multiple entry points, giving full credit, and making work accessible to outsiders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use hospitality as an explicit evaluative axis alongside technical merit: ask whether the piece anticipates a reader's difficulties, offers on-ramps, credits others, avoids gatekeeping jargon, and actively invites newcomers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concrete opening example (hospitality)
rubrics_metrics.description: A hospitable exposition begins with a concrete example a non-specialist can follow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Start expositions with accessible examples to provide an intuitive foothold; anti-patterns include beginning with abstract generalities that alienate newcomers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Define non-standard terms on first use (hospitality)
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines every non-standard term on first use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid assuming specialized background; provide clear definitions early so readers unfamiliar with jargon can follow without barriers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cite generously, including underrepresented contributors (hospitality)
rubrics_metrics.description: Cites generously, including underrepresented contributors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give full credit broadly and inclusively; use citation practices that recognize diverse contributors and reduce erasure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admit messy history (hospitality)
rubrics_metrics.description: Admits the messy history of how the result was found.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be transparent about the development process and false starts; this humanizes mathematics and helps learners see realistic paths to results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Welcome alternative perspectives in prose (hospitality)
rubrics_metrics.description: Welcomes alternative perspectives in the prose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present multiple viewpoints and approaches rather than a single authoritative narrative; value pluralism in explanation and method.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid jargon as gatekeeping (hospitality)
rubrics_metrics.description: Does not use jargon as a gatekeeping device.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use technical terms thoughtfully and only when necessary; provide explanations and avoid intentionally exclusionary language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer an on-ramp for outsiders before technical core (hospitality)
rubrics_metrics.description: Offers an 'on-ramp' for outsiders before going to the technical core.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accessible introductions, motivational examples, and intuitive explanations prior to formal development to broaden readership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation to others
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the work invites others into the field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate if the work actively lowers barriers and attracts participation (through exposition, pedagogy, outreach); a hospitable piece invites engagement rather than gatekeeping.

rubrics_metrics.name: Care for the community
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the practice exhibits care for the community of practitioners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess practices for mentorship, crediting, inclusiveness, and policies that sustain colleagues and learners; prefer work that strengthens communal bonds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of mathematical truth for human flourishing
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether mathematical truth is being used in service of human flourishing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider the broader impacts and ethical uses of mathematics; value work that applies mathematical understanding toward human well-being, justice, and flourishing.
